versions.content: Attribute prefix of IncludedModeDeclarationGroupSet The optional attribute prefix of IncludedModeDeclarationGroupSet can be used to define a prefix that the RTE generator shall use to define symbols related to the included ModeDeclarationGroup s with the intent to avoid potential name clashes.
